notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for a successful RTIambassador::getDimensionHandle invocation and the separately specified NameNotFound failure, both reported through HLAreportServiceInvocation. RL-421 identifies the positive-return candidate but records a conflicting subsection; RL-423's source-layout audit confirms §10.23.3 is Preconditions, so the positive result is mapped to main service clause §10.23 rather than the Lab-exported §10.22.6 or mislabeled §10.23.3 field. The undefined-name exception is §10.23.5. The asserted report forms are limited to the returned DimensionHandle and Null failure return in §11.5.1; no mapping is claimed for every argument type or the whole MOM clause. Federation setup reuses the existing federation execution API contract. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM (including the tested dimension name), standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies lookup results, service classification, typed arguments, reliable report delivery, reporter identity, success/exception state, and report serials. Provider-private headers, registries, routing, file sinks, names, and diagnostics are outside this contract.
